theorems.name: Submission.dmcbr_ci_density_representation
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Γ : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n) (η₀ : ℝ), 0 < η₀ → μ univ < ∞ → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → Γ.massOn W = μ W) → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ → (∀ (x : Euclid P) (α : Covector (Euclid P) n), |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, Γ ω = ∫ x, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μ) → (∀ E : Set (Euclid P), μHE[n] E = 0 → μ E = 0) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ENNReal.ofReal η₀ ≤ liminf (fun r : ℝ => μ (ball x r) / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0)) → ∃ (M : Set (Euclid P)) (θ : Euclid P → ℝ) (ζ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n), MeasurableSet M ∧ μHE[n] M < ∞ ∧ Measurable θ ∧ StronglyMeasurable ζ ∧ μ = (μHE[n].restrict M).withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (θ x)) ∧ (∀ x ∈ M, 0 < θ x) ∧ (∀ (x : Euclid P) (α : Covector (Euclid P) n), |ζ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) ∧ (∀ x ∈ M, ∃ β : Covector (Euclid P) n, covectorEuclideanNorm β ≤ 1 ∧ ζ x β = 1) ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, Γ ω = ∫ x in M, θ x * ζ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μHE[n]) ∧ (∀ x ∈ M, ENNReal.ofReal η₀ ≤ liminf (fun r : ℝ => μ (ball x r) / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
